summary: Opt-in Desktop demo recording primitives; not part of Workspace, Attempt, or evaluation state.
architecture_notes: Suite contracts describe case identity, drivers, chapters, and recording defaults while typed drivers keep workflow logic in TypeScript.
CDP screencast records the existing Electron page; it never opens a replacement page or changes product state.
Session observation stores only sanitized lifecycle metadata. Raw prompts, reasoning, tool arguments, outputs, credentials, and local paths remain in memory and are never demo artifacts.
Durable session and Project Host readback prove completion independently of the recording, and scoring remains outside this package.
